ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Token, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (GiantRock.cs:16-19) == cost 1 / ATTACK / TOKEN / ANY_ENEMY. TOKEN rarity keeps it out of every reward and generation pool on both sides; it exists only because Primal Force creates it.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(16m, ValueProp.Move)` (GiantRock.cs:14) == `_damage = 16`, powered on both sides.

OnPlay.rationale: `DamageCmd.Attack(16).FromCard(this).Targeting(cardPlay.Target)` (GiantRock.cs:24-26) == the sim's single `DamageCmd.deal(..., dealer=ctx.player, card=self)`. No follow-up effect and no guard on either side.
